doc: The wake header's words: the one-line label and the message under it for each turn_wake shape.
internal/marotte WakeLine is the server reader (the rail's first line and the Markdown export) and
static-src/turn-wake.ts wakeText the client's (the header, the rail and Copy as text); both read
these cases, so a wording change lands in both or fails one.
Expected values follow the approved wording, not either implementation. A run's name is its
run_label, else the id's first 11 characters (`wf_` plus eight).
